name: somshrestha-claude-prompt-monitor
description: Tracks every Claude Code prompt — live progress, elapsed time, estimated time to completion, and a notification the moment the prompt finishes. Works for both the Claude Code VS Code extension and terminal sessions.

claudePromptMonitor.enabled.description: Master switch for watching Claude Code sessions.

claudePromptMonitor.scope.description: Which sessions to track. 'workspace' only tracks sessions whose working directory is inside an open workspace folder; 'all' tracks every Claude Code session on this machine.

claudePromptMonitor.notifyOnComplete.description: Show a notification when a prompt finishes.

claudePromptMonitor.notifyMinDurationSec.description: Skip the completion notification for prompts that finish faster than this.

claudePromptMonitor.notifyOnlyWhenUnfocu.description: Only notify when the VS Code window is not focused.

enumDescriptions: A VS Code notification inside the editor window.
A desktop notification from the operating system, which is visible while VS Code is minimised.
claudePromptMonitor.notificationTarget.description: Where the completion notification is shown.

claudePromptMonitor.overlayAutoStart.description: Open the always-on-top desktop widget automatically whenever a prompt starts. Windows only. The widget runs as its own process and stays open until you close it, including after VS Code is closed.

claudePromptMonitor.playSound.description: Play a short system sound when a prompt finishes.

claudePromptMonitor.showProgressNotifica.description: Show a live progress notification (with a bar driven by the ETA) while a prompt is running.

claudePromptMonitor.statusBar.description: Show elapsed time and ETA in the status bar while a prompt is running.

claudePromptMonitor.claudeHome.description: Override the Claude Code home directory. Defaults to $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude.

claudePromptMonitor.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to poll transcript files for new output, in milliseconds.

claudePromptMonitor.staleTurnMinutes.description: A running turn with no new transcript output for this long is treated as abandoned.

claudePromptMonitor.historySize.description: How many completed turns to keep per project for estimating durations.
